definition: Assessing how safe a scene or street appears — used in urban analytics and autonomous driving context modeling.
details: Assessing how safe a scene or street appears — used in urban analytics and autonomous driving context modeling.

explainer.lead: Safety perception recognition assesses how safe a scene or street appears. It matters in urban analytics and autonomous driving context modeling.

tiers.eli5: It is an AI's guess at whether a street looks safe or unsafe from the scene itself.
tiers.practitioner: Used to score scenes and streets for perceived safety in urban analytics and as context modeling for autonomous driving.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as assessing how safe a scene or street appears, applied in urban analytics and autonomous driving context modeling. Limits: it measures perceived safety from appearance, not verified actual safety.

explainer.example: A model rates a street scene as looking safe or unsafe, feeding an urban analytics study of perceived safety.
